snippet.title: Abandoned Below – Official Trailer | Co-op/Single Player Horror | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
The free Abandoned Below demo is OUT NOW on Steam!

Play the demo and wishlist the full game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5415090/Abandoned_Below/

Descend into an abandoned underground bunker and face relentless waves of zombies in this co-op horror FPS. Barricade entrances, unlock new areas, and fight to survive.

Abandoned Below is taking part in Steam Scream V Fest. Grab your friends and try the demo!

#AbandonedBelow #CoopHorror #SteamDemo
